text: the fine is still not fine enough. the item is barely 1m in length. the smallest paint is 0.8 that is effectively still the whole damn thing
resolution: Made paint detail go much finer for a small (~1m) item. Two limits caused 'the finest is still the whole face': (1) GRID_MAX capped a face at 64 cells, so a metre-scale face could never get smaller cells no matter the setting; (2) the finest preset (0.12u) was still coarse for the small detail faces a gun is made of. Fixes: raised GRID_MAX 64->256 (safe because only PAINTED cells bake and they are run-merged, and the hover overlay now STRIDES its grid lines to ~40 per axis so a many-cell face stays cheap to draw); made the 'detail' presets genuinely fine — ultra 0.03u (~0.2cm) / fine 0.08 / med 0.2 / coarse 0.5 / XL 1.2 — and lowered the default to 0.08. Verified the cell math out-of-band: a 1m face now yields 200x200 cells at default, a 12cm face 25x25, a 3cm face 7x7 (17x17 at ultra), so brush-1 is a small dab at every scale (vs the old 1-cell-per-face). Build clean; meshPaint 8/8. Needs rjit dev to confirm live: on the gun, brush-1 should now be a small dab; tap detail->ultra for the finest. shas 85e8358e8.
